messages:
alex_t: quick idea — what if we split the adapter surface into two tiny contracts: (1) control-plane manifest + creds handshake, (2) runtime call façade. keep the control-plane stable across hosted/dedicated/private and let runtime adapters opt-in to extra capabilities.

maria_w: can you sketch what the manifest would contain? thinking about secrets, KMS bindings, and who rotates what.

alex_t: rough sketch: `manifest.v1` fields: provider, model_id, allowed_features, auth_kind (token/kms/hsm), telemetry_sink. minimal and versioned so we can add flags later. example snippet:```json
{
  "provider": "redwood-hosted",
  "model_id": "rw/v1-llama2-13b",
  "auth_kind": "kms",
  "telemetry_sink": "rt-ingest:abc"
}
```

jun_park: main tension is secrets lifecycle. Dedicated/private often want customer-managed KMS; hosted wants short-lived tokens. I like decoupling auth_kind so control plane only negotiates intent (e.g., "kms:customer") and the runtime adapter handles exchange.

samira: rollout question — how do we migrate existing adapters without a big cutover? can we default to a compatibility shim that maps new manifest -> old fields?

alex_t: yes, plan is: 1) introduce manifest.v1 as opt-in flag on routes, 2) ship shim in runtime that consumes manifest and emits legacy config, 3) monitor errors/latency for 2 weeks, then flip default.

maria_w: telemetry: we need tenant-level correlation. prefer the manifest include a `telemetry_labels` map so runtime can attach tenant_id and route. also add `observability_hint` for sampling.

jun_park: fallback semantics: if runtime adapter can't honor a capability (e.g., KV-cache), we should surface a machine-readable reason code so control-plane can fall back to compatible model variant. propose codes like `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY:kv_cache`

alex_t: agreed — machine-readable fallback codes + human log. that lets routing pick cheaper model or move to hosted/dedicated tier.

samira: ops-bot FYI when the shim is deployed to staging can we auto-create a canary route? @ops-bot

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started deploy of `adapter-shim:v0.3` to staging (staging-cluster-3). link: https://deploys/redwood/adapter-shim/v0.3 :rocket:

maria_w: one more callout — audit & secrets: manifest should reference secrets by stable resource ids, not inline. that lets dedicated/private exchange pointers to their KMS without leaking keys.

jun_park: also check latency SLOs: adding an extra handshake on cold-start could add 20–50ms. we should allow a `keep_warm` hint in manifest or cacheable prefetch tokens in control-plane.

alex_t: good point. add `keep_warm: boolean` + `prefetch_ttl_sec`. default false.

samira: next steps: alex to draft RFC with manifest fields + migration playbook; Jun to add secret-handback flow; Maria to write telemetry labels proposal. I'll collect in one doc and we can sync Wed 10am. :calendar:

alex_t: on it. will post RFC link in this thread once drafted.

ops-bot: reminder: architecture sync Wed 10:00a in #all-hands.
